poll.question: As evening settles, Maggie plans her early town run. Should Cole and Sawyer:

options.label: Rise early, work
options.desc: The roof knack is hot—keep the momentum rolling toward winter

options.label: Slow morning together
options.desc: Day 7 is strained—everyone might need a quiet, easy start

options.label: Work at dawn, then slow
options.desc: Get the early hours while sharp, then breakfast together before she leaves

in_play.label: One more day fishing
in_play.desc: Let Sawyer teach; the boys need this, and we need the food
